// Raw C# event/delegate/subscription fixture for the .NET inventory analyzer.
// The .txt suffix keeps tooling from treating it as real C# source. Named
// positive cases and false-positive traps are included. No consumer identifiers.

namespace Sample.Events
{
    // Delegate type declaration.
    public delegate void MessageHandler(object sender, int payload);

    public class Publisher
    {
        // Field-like event declaration.
        public event MessageHandler Started;

        // Field-like event using the framework EventHandler type.
        public event EventHandler Completed;

        // Custom-accessor event declaration (add/remove form).
        public event EventHandler Custom
        {
            add { }
            remove { }
        }
    }

    public class Subscriber
    {
        public void Wire(Publisher publisher, int total)
        {
            // Subscription using a lambda handler.
            publisher.Started += (sender, payload) => Handle(payload);

            // Subscription using a method-group handler (bare dotted identifier).
            publisher.Completed += this.OnCompleted;

            // Subscription using a new EventHandler delegate construction.
            publisher.Completed += new EventHandler(this.OnCompleted);

            // Unsubscription using a method group.
            publisher.Completed -= this.OnCompleted;

            // Trap: arithmetic compound assignment must NOT be detected.
            total += 3;

            // Trap: verbatim string containing subscription-shaped text.
            var verbatimTrap = @"handler += SomeHandler";

            // Trap: interpolated string containing subscription-shaped text.
            var interpolatedTrap = $"count {total} += Other";
        }

        private void OnCompleted(object sender, EventArgs args)
        {
        }

        private void Handle(int payload)
        {
        }
    }
}
